This plan rescues 8 of the 10 people and defers the 2 shopkeepers at Bidur village, for a total cost of 158.

Trishuli shelter is the only evacuation point, so every rescued person has to end up there. The Trishuli–Naukunda road is closed, so both trips go through Gosaikunda temple.

- **Naukunda farm trip (46 min):** This rescues 4 adults and avoids a deferral penalty of 80.
- **Dupcheshwar temple trip (72 min):** This rescues 4 adults and avoids a deferral penalty of 80, a net saving of only 8, but still a saving.
- **Bidur village (2 adults):** Deferring them costs 40. Reaching them adds 44 minutes of driving, and the car would be full, so deferring is cheaper.

Total cost is 46 + 72 driving minutes + 40 deferral penalty = 158.

<plan>
drive car1 trishuli-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple naukunda-farm
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 naukunda-farm gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple trishuli-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
drive car1 trishuli-shelter gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple dupcheshwar-temple
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 dupcheshwar-temple gosaikunda-temple
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple trishuli-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
defer bidur-village adult 2
</plan>
